missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Стекло' is a neuter noun in the nominative as the subject. 'Это' points at a specific pane, and 'тонкое' is the agreeing neuter adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Стекло' is neuter, so its accusative matches the nominative as the object of 'разбил'. 'Мальчик' is the subject, and 'случайно' is the adverb.
Strategic focus: Accusative after через. 'Стекло' is the accusative after 'через' showing through what one looks. 'Сад' is the object of the impersonal 'видно'.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'На стекле' uses the prepositional form 'стекле' after 'на' to locate the drops. 'Капли' is the nominative subject of 'появились'.
Strategic focus: Genitive of material. 'Стекла' is the genitive showing what the shards are made of. 'Осколки' is the nominative subject, and 'на полу' locates them.
Strategic focus: Genitive after из. 'Стекла' is the genitive after 'из' showing the material. 'Бутылка' is the nominative subject, and 'сделана' is the short passive participle.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after со. 'Стеклом' is the instrumental after 'со' showing what one works with. 'Мастер' is the subject, and 'аккуратно' is the adverb.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural with ё. 'Стёкла' is the irregular nominative plural of 'стекло', spelled with ё, as the subject. 'Большие' and 'чистые' agree in the plural.

missions.phrase: Я вымыл все стёкла в окнах.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Стёкла' is the inanimate accusative plural, identical to the nominative, as the object of 'вымыл'. 'Все' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural after за. 'Стёклами' is the instrumental plural after 'за' showing position behind the panes. 'Огни' is the nominative subject.
